title: TelemetryConfigurationEvent
description: Schema of all properties of a telemetry configuration event

telemetry_sample_rate.description: The percentage of telemetry events sent

telemetry_configuration_sample_rate.description: The percentage of telemetry configuration events sent after being sampled by telemetry_sample_rate

telemetry_usage_sample_rate.description: The percentage of telemetry usage events sent after being sampled by telemetry_sample_rate

trace_context_injection.description: The opt-in configuration to add trace context

premium_sample_rate.description: The percentage of sessions with Browser RUM & Session Replay pricing tracked (deprecated in favor of session_replay_sample_rate)

replay_sample_rate.description: The percentage of sessions with Browser RUM & Session Replay pricing tracked (deprecated in favor of session_replay_sample_rate)

session_replay_sample_rate.description: The percentage of sessions with RUM & Session Replay pricing tracked

start_session_replay_recording_manually.description: Whether the session replay start is handled manually

start_recording_immediately.description: Whether Session Replay should automatically start a recording when enabled

session_replay_canvas_recording.description: Whether canvas elements are recorded in Session Replay

session_replay_canvas_recording_quality.description: The quality preset requested for canvas recording in Session Replay

use_before_send.description: Whether beforeSend callback function is used

silent_multiple_init.description: Whether initialization fails silently if the SDK is already initialized

track_session_across_subdomains.description: Whether sessions across subdomains for the same site are tracked

track_bfcache_views.description: Whether views loaded from the bfcache are tracked

use_cross_site_session_cookie.description: Whether a secure cross-site session cookie is used (deprecated)

use_partitioned_cross_site_session_cooki.description: Whether a partitioned secure cross-site session cookie is used

use_secure_session_cookie.description: Whether a secure session cookie is used

allow_fallback_to_local_storage.description: Whether it is allowed to use LocalStorage when cookies are not available (deprecated in favor of session_persistence)

session_persistence.description: Configure the storage strategy for persisting sessions

store_contexts_across_pages.description: Whether contexts are stored in local storage

action_name_attribute.description: Attribute to be used to name actions

use_allowed_tracing_origins.description: Whether the allowed tracing origins list is used (deprecated in favor of use_allowed_tracing_urls)

use_allowed_tracing_urls.description: Whether the allowed tracing urls list is used

use_allowed_graph_ql_urls.description: Whether the allowed GraphQL urls list is used

use_track_graph_ql_payload.description: Whether GraphQL payload tracking is used for at least one GraphQL endpoint

use_track_graph_ql_response_errors.description: Whether GraphQL response errors tracking is used for at least one GraphQL endpoint

selected_tracing_propagators.description: A list of selected tracing propagators

text_and_input_privacy_level.description: Session replay text and input privacy level

use_excluded_activity_urls.description: Whether the request origins list to ignore when computing the page activity is used

use_worker_url.description: Whether the Worker is loaded from an external URL

track_views_manually.description: Whether the RUM views creation is handled manually

track_interactions.description: Whether user actions are tracked (deprecated in favor of track_user_interactions)

forward_errors_to_logs.description: Whether console.error logs, uncaught exceptions and network errors are tracked

number_of_displays.description: The number of displays available to the device

forward_reports.description: The reports from the Reporting API tracked

swiftui_view_tracking_enabled.description: Whether SwiftUI view instrumentation is enabled

swiftui_action_tracking_enabled.description: Whether SwiftUI action instrumentation is enabled

track_background_events.description: Whether RUM events are tracked when the application is in Background

mobile_vitals_update_period.description: The period between each Mobile Vital sample (in milliseconds)

track_errors.description: Whether error monitoring & crash reporting is enabled for the source platform

track_network_requests.description: Whether automatic collection of network requests is enabled

track_native_views.description: Whether native views are tracked (for cross platform SDKs)

track_native_errors.description: Whether native error monitoring & crash reporting is enabled (for cross platform SDKs)

track_native_long_tasks.description: Whether long task tracking is performed automatically

track_cross_platform_long_tasks.description: Whether long task tracking is performed automatically for cross platform SDKs

use_first_party_hosts.description: Whether the client has provided a list of first party hosts

initialization_type.description: The type of initialization the SDK used, in case multiple are supported

track_flutter_performance.description: Whether Flutter build and raster time tracking is enabled

batch_size.description: The window duration for batches sent by the SDK (in milliseconds)

batch_upload_frequency.description: The upload frequency of batches (in milliseconds)

batch_processing_level.description: Maximum number of batches processed sequentially without a delay

background_tasks_enabled.description: Whether UIApplication background tasks are enabled

react_version.description: The version of React used in a ReactNative application

react_native_version.description: The version of ReactNative used in a ReactNative application

dart_version.description: The version of Dart used in a Flutter application

unity_version.description: The version of Unity used in a Unity application

maui_version.description: The version of MAUI used in a .NET MAUI application

app_hang_threshold.description: The threshold used for iOS App Hangs monitoring (in milliseconds)

use_pci_intake.description: Whether logs are sent to the PCI-compliant intake

tracer_api.description: The tracer API used by the SDK. Possible values: 'Datadog', 'OpenTelemetry', 'OpenTracing'

tracer_api_version.description: The version of the tracer API used by the SDK. Eg. '0.1.0'

send_logs_after_session_expiration.description: Whether logs are sent after the session expiration

is_main_process.description: Whether the SDK is initialised on the application's main or a secondary process

inv_time_threshold_ms.description: Interval in milliseconds when the last action is considered as the action that created the next view. Only sent if a time based strategy has been used

tns_time_threshold_ms.description: The interval in milliseconds during which all network requests will be considered as initial, i.e. caused by the creation of this view. Only sent if a time based strategy has been used

track_feature_flags_for_events.description: The list of events that include feature flags collection. The tracking is always enabled for views and errors.

track_anonymous_user.description: Whether the anonymous users are tracked

use_allowed_tracking_origins.description: Whether a list of allowed origins is used to control SDK execution in browser extension contexts. When enabled, the SDK will check if the current origin matches the allowed origins list before running.

sdk_version.description: The version of the SDK that is running.

source.description: The source of the SDK, e.g., 'browser', 'ios', 'android', 'flutter', 'react-native', 'unity', 'kotlin-multiplatform', 'maui'.

variant.description: The variant of the SDK build (e.g., standard, lite, etc.).

remote_configuration_id.description: The id of the remote configuration

use_remote_configuration_proxy.description: Whether a proxy is used for remote configuration

remote_configuration.description: Metadata of the remote configuration currently applied for this session

config_id.description: Identifier of the remote configuration bundle this metadata belongs to

version_id.description: CDN version identifier of the applied configuration

last_modified.description: CDN publish timestamp of the applied configuration, in ms from epoch

last_synced.description: Timestamp at which the device fetched and cached this configuration version, in ms from epoch

first_applied.description: Timestamp at which this configuration version was first observed as applied by the device, in ms from epoch. Stamped once and reused on every subsequent session that runs on the same version

sync_id.description: Identifier of the sync that produced this configuration version, used to deduplicate repeat sessions from the same device without a persistent identifier

profiling_sample_rate.description: The percentage of sessions with Continuous profiling enabled

profiling_application_launch_sample_rate.description: The percentage of sessions with Application Launch profiling enabled. For mobile SDKs, this is the sampling rate of application launch profiling

profiling_anr_enabled.description: Whether collecting a profile when an ANR occurs is enabled on Android

propagate_trace_baggage.description: Whether trace baggage is propagated to child spans

track_resource_headers.description: How the SDK tracks resource request/response headers

beta_encode_cookie_options.description: Whether the beta encode cookie options is enabled

beta_enable_view_updates.description: Whether the beta partial view updates feature is enabled

beta_track_web_sockets.description: Whether the beta track WebSockets feature is enabled

use_client_side_stats.description: Whether tracing feature's client-side-stats generation is enabled

use_trace_sampling_rules.description: Whether trace sampling rules are configured
